candidates.method: On the 40 unchanged PUBLIC FIT examples learn original affine and precommitted Feistel model; select original AZ margin0 task-wide route using the 8 original PUBLIC CHECK examples. Only if both alternatives are independently eligible under existing affine FIT <=12, original model CHECK>=96 and Feistel CHECK>=96 AND the original selected model's aggregate public CHECK margin is <=8 bits, inspect disagreements. On each of the same 8 public CHECK examples compute chosen inverse bit-correctness versus alternate inverse bit-correctness. If any row shows the alternate beating chosen by >=2 bits (veto2) or >=4 bits (veto4), abstain the entire task. Otherwise leave original route unchanged. If only one model eligible or public margin >8, leave unchanged. If original route abstains, retain abstention. Never use graph predicted acceptance label, graph truth, operator name, oracle inverse, case family, task source ID or past scored outcomes to route; source task nonce allowed only as original affine deterministic RANSAC seed.
candidates.risk: Disagreement is task-level public support diagnostics, not a guarantee it can identify false positives. 2/4 thresholds frozen prior to research; full positive retention and demonstrated correction required.

prospective_rule.FIT: A new disagreement arm must eliminate >=1 false-positive case accepted by matched unmodified original joint baseline; have zero candidate FP; maintain all matched original joint positive accepted case IDs, all matched original affine positive accepted case IDs, >=1 Feistel paired positive, and strictly more paired correct than best equal-48 affine control. Select at most one new disagreement mode using 24 FIT tasks only by highest paired correct, lowest CPU, then fixed lexical name.
prospective_rule.SCREEN: On completely disjoint 24 held TRAIN-SCREEN cases, FIT-elected disagreement mode must again eliminate >=1 original joint FP, have zero candidate FP, preserve all matched joint and matched affine positive accepted case identities, have >=1 Feistel paired positive and strictly outperform best equal-48 affine baseline. Never retune thresholds or elect from SCREEN.
prospective_rule.DEV: Only if both FIT and SCREEN strict requirements pass, a new separately frozen exact-head prospective DEV gate may be designed. This gate must not instantiate either DEV cohort.
